Beautiful. The soundtrack of Man.

So I have never played a single Kingdom Hearts game myself, but my best friend played all of them. She was so excited when KH3 came out, she was extatic for months, and later cried and vented to me about the ending. I really tried to read into it, learn about the plot of KH so we could have some more things to talk about, well, I figured out that understanding KH lore is quite a daunting task. I still don’t know everything, but i know barely enough to get the rough idea of it. Well, a few months later, in august, my friend passed away from her leukemia at 15 after 3 years of fighting. it was a small funeral, with many beautiful blue flowers, we were handed a schedule of the ceremony. The first song to play was one that she had chosen herself.
“Don’t think twice” by Hikaru Utada. I had never heard it before then, i only knew Dearly beloved, but now i can only think of her when I listen to this song.
I miss you Elina.
2004-2019.
Edit: I just want to thank you for all the kind comments, i read every single one.

stories.text:
I'm hoping KH4 will feature Kairi as the playable protagonist with Donald and Goofy serving as her partners just as they did with Sora. It's about time she graduated from damsel in distress to a hero in her own right. While Riku searches for Sora, Yen Sid instructs Kairi to visit different worlds and identify the new 7 hearts after Maleficent and Pete steal a Gummiphone and gives it to Pete's old friend Emil Eagle to see if the data inside will be any good to them. At the same time they also try to find info on the masked people (the lost Masters of course) they saw Xigbar with before they take the Black Box from him. In case Mleficent decides to go after the other princesses, Yen Sid orders Terra, Ventus, Aqua, Roxas, Xion, and Axel to guard Snow White, Cinderella, Aurora, Alice, Belle, and Jasmine respectively. Since it will be her first time traveling through the worlds, Donald, Goofy, and Jiminy decide to go with her to watch her back. As for Mickey, he's tasked with following aleficent and Pete. This mission will serve as Kairi’s Mark of Mastery. Before she starts her journey, each character bestows Kairi a magic ability: Fire (Axel), Blizzard (Isa), Thunder (Roxas), Magnet (Xion), Earth or Gravity (Terra), Water (Aqua), Aero (Ventus), Cure (Namine), and Stop (Mickey).

The worlds Kairi visits will be based on these movies and in the following order:

Brave 
Frozen 2
Cinderella 3
The Little Mermaid 2
Pocahontas
The Princess & The Frog
Mulan 2
Moana
Aladdin & The King Of Thieves
Winnie The Pooh (2011) 

The worlds for Tangled the series and Snow White would also be visited but only in cutscenes. Radiant Garden and the Bug Blocks will return. Pocahontas, Tiana, Anna, Rapunzel, and Moana will be confirmed to be 5 of the new hearts. There will also be 6 summons: Olaf, Fairy Godmother, Maui, Genie, Mushu, and the 7 Dwarfs. During all this time, there will be cutscenes of Sora and Riku's time in Quadratum and after clearing all the Disney worlds, Kairi, Donald, and Goofy find their way there and join up with them for the final battles.

Towards the end, everyone learns a startling truth. When the X-Blade was broken into 7 lights and 13 darknesses, not only did the 7 lights become the hearts for the 7 Princesses, but the 13 darknesses became the hearts for 13 of the most black hearted villains, the 13 Lords of Darkness. And all of them must be reunited to recreate the X-Blade. 

I also came up with 2 side games:

First there is "KH: Mickey's Quest". This game takes place during the first. It will focus on what Mickey was doing while Goofy and Donald were traveling with Sora. The worlds Mickey visits are based on Gummi Bears, Leroy & Stitch, Bambi 2, Song of the South, The Wind In The Willows, Bedknobs & Broomsticks, Darkwing Duck, and The Great Mouse Detective.

The second is "KH: Bonds of Time" which will follow Roxas and Xion going on a special mission together. This will take place either before or after KH4. Yen Sid has the two of them go back in time to the days of the lost masters to learn more about them and their successors, 2 of whom they recognize as Ventus and Marluxia. Before they arrive in Daybreak Town, they travel to different times in various worlds. The worlds they visit are based on: Beauty & The Beast, The Sword In The Stone, The Hunchback Of Notre Dame 2
, Tarzan 2, Alice In Wonderland, The Lion King, The Little Mermaid 3, 101 Dalmations, and Ducktales The Movie: Treasure Of The Lost Lamp. I chose these movies so we can see their worlds done right with the new graphics and all and we can interact with the young version of Tarzan and Simba. We will also get to fight Gaston, Madam Mim, Cruella, and Merlock. Jiminy procures the aid of Bernard and Miss Bianca from "The Rescuers" to join Roxas and Xion to watch their backs and chronicle their journey on his behalf using the Gummi Phones. The gameplay for this game will be similar to Birth By Sleep only you don't have to create 3 games for 3 separate characters. Instead the player will be able to switch between Roxas and Xion during the journey and battles. Plus if one gets knocked out, the player will automatically be able to switch to the other and heal them when they can. Although both characters can be used, some abilities and techniques will be exclusive to each of them as they level up.

However, if KH4 is going to once again have Sora as the playing character. I hope at least 9 to 10 of these movies will be featured as new worlds.

stories.author: @devegas4910
stories.text:
So I realized why this song makes me so emotional: this is about a journey. 

In the first verse, we are introduced to someone in the state of dilemma. They’re asking themselves if they should take the risk “taste, what a bittersweet” makes it clear that this is something they’ve wanted but at the same time, they’ll be forced to leave behind what they love in order to achieve it. 

The hook makes it clear that they’re afraid of what it is that they want for many reasons. The losses, the failures, the many times they’ll fall down and feel broken. “It won’t be long, I’m almost here” is what keeps them going. Even through the tears. 

The second verse is drastically different from the first. Not different in how the lyrics are arranged, but in how the person has grown from their initial state of fear. It’s in no way over, but they’ve become more confident and self assured. They’re not afraid of the outcome anymore and are willing to risk everything now. 

Throughout the song, the instrumental demonstrates the path the person decides to walk. The heavy bass and dubstep is the chaos of the journey itself as it’s hard hitting and unpredictable at times. The piano is the calm throughout the storm. 

As we get closer to the end of the song, the bridge gives them a final obstacle. They fight through it with all of their might though and as we get to hook being sung one last time, it represents the journey’s end. Whether you’ve interpreted the subject to have fallen or succeeded, they are still proud of their decision to move forward and make the sacrifice.

stories.author: @ATLAS_TELAMON
stories.text:
Kingdom Hearts has always occupied an interesting space in my mind. In the dichotomy of: 'emotional, fun game' and 'loosely thrown together plot-hole fest', people tend to fall squarely on one side or the other. Personally, I think I'm on the fence. I grew up with these games, yet I'm intimately aware of what all these titles do wrong. Lately, I can barely play any of the games except for 1 simply because of all the problems I can't help but see with them. Why is it then, that I can't listen to this music without breaking into a sobbing fit? After all, KH3 released years after my cynicism regarding the franchise was solidified; I even found the game itself wanting. But despite the unrewarding gameplay, the refusal to break from the relatively familiar; I couldn't help but sob for fifteen minutes straight after the finale. Further, I know I'll be purchasing the DLC the day it comes out. Why? I know that, logically speaking, I won't find it any more fun than I did the base game. 


Because Kingdom Hearts is mine. In my unique human experience, where constant things are so rare and ephemeral.. Kingdom Hearts has been a constant. Even now, as an adult, it's still there. Every time I play any of the games, the feeling I felt when I was a child is, for just a moment, recalled. My cynicism is briefly dispelled as the opening sequences play. Some would call this nostalgia; I would call it more than that. It's an unexplainable thing; like the idea of seeing a dead family member, or a friend you never thought you'd see again. I never expect to boot up these games and feel anything other than disappointment. Yet I do. I feel happy and melancholic to the point of tears, without fail.


That's why I cry when I play Kingdom Hearts. That's why I support it so feverishly, even though I know how flawed it really is. Kingdom Hearts doesn't make me feel like I'm a kid again.


For just a second, it MAKES me a kid again.

stories.author: @jtotheroc
stories.text: I had to pull my car over to write this. I think as with any other fan of kingdoms hearts who have been with the series since the very beginning, we become very emotional with this song. For the majority of us, we were teenagers when the first one released, and now we're in our early 30- mid 30s when KH3 released. For me, I get very sentimental listening to this song and being fortunate to experience Sora and companies story since release. Been waiting for KH3 since finishing KH2 back in 2005, and it finally came 15 years later, and now, I have to say goodbye to this series, and I honestly didn't want it to end. I think this song is the best song in the franchise, it if metaphorical for Soras relationship with all his friends, especially his (I hope) girlfriend, Kairi. As soon as this song started playing following the credits (and absolutely losing my shit when I saw axel, Roxas, Lea, and Xion sitting on the belltower) I couldn't stop bawling like a child, and this is coming from a 35 year old grown man with a 7 year old son, especially when everyone's playing on the beach, finally able to love free from the darkness that Xehenort brought into the world, and then we pan to Kairi and Sora, holding hands, finally able to be with one another after multiple games apart, and then Sora just vanishes (and that probably hurt the most). So yeah, this song is very sentimental to myself, as well as other kingdom hearts fans and that's why we get emotional whenever we hear/have to watch it. I've been KH3 now about 5 times, and I still cry like a baby when this song starts playing.

stories.text:
I only ever asked for respect. I got nothing.. So now I sit here wondering.. how can I live with myself.. for trying to do everything and nothing on my own.. all at once.. by using the powers of nothingness, in other words.. doing nothing for the sake of a task... and also using even my own dreams to understand my life. I've grown pained. I've grown regretful of others. I stopped caring if I was happy. I stopped caring if I lived on. I started crossing the street without looking... Because I knew I wouldn't get hurt.. I started not caring what others thought of me.. because I called myself a hero for using my talents to simply live without them.

I did all I could, yet I got nothing for it. I was ok for a while.. but that's because it hasn't built up yet. As I grew older, I understood that I can not accept this anymore. I've used my dreams and my knowledge to control the future how i see fit.. I had everything I could ever want, so why is it... that I asked for respect? it's because I was bullied. Treated like crap my whole life. Never had a friend that lasted more than a couple years, at first.. I was fine. but it's only after I got something special that I understood just how hopeless and pointless everything else has been..

I had the ability to make my own path.. yet everyone was making the path dark and twisted. I had others trying to control my every action. we call these parents and teachers, I call them weakness and slave masters. Why? Because to me... I only knew bullying and hate. I never got anything I wanted from anyone else. So even the ones closest to me... I would always think they would regret being close to me. I always think they would leave me or hate me too. I don't believe in a Life alone. Nor do I believe in this world being stronger than my background, All I do is put up with people.. Thinking they can do something for me.. and yet they always backfire, because they never respected me.. enough is enough. I'm not putting up with this anymore. It's too much now.

I would rather die, than put up with anymore annoyance. I just needed someone to be with. I didn't care who it was... or how it goes about.. but this is just sad. All I did was protect what really matters, while everyone else thinks I'm just some random dude. Heh. that's fine. But if you must think of me wrong, then I'll do whatever I want. I have the right to act the way that I want to, if you'll just treat me like everyone else. No. No more pain.

No more regrets. Oh well.. I guess I can't get better from this illness then. All of these actions they took have made it incurable. that's a shame... I would have hoped I could live longer and not be killed by the very people who think I'm just fine. but by all means, keep messing with me if you wish..... I don't care about this life anymore.
